title: Site-Specific Sectioning and SEM Imaging of MOSFET Active Regions for Device Failure Analysis
content: Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Metal Oxide Semiconductor Field Effect Transistor (MOSFET) devices are widely used in industrial and consumer applications. However, their compact size and intricate structures pose significant challenges in identifying the root causes of device failures, especially when the internal structure is obscured by the packaging. To determine failure causes, it is necessary to remove the outer layers of material to expose internal structures and possible points of failure. Given the numerous possible failure points in these devices, localizing the failure with site-selective methods is crucial.
